aboleth_lesser_prime.name: Aboleth Mucus Sac
aboleth_lesser_prime.description: The slime sac of an aboleth, the ancient fish that remembers the world before men. Its memory still glows in the mucus.

abyssal_behemoth_prime.name: Abyssal Behemoth Blood
abyssal_behemoth_prime.description: Blood from the great beast of the Abyss, the size of a hill and always hungry. One flask is a feast.

abyssal_dragon_prime.name: Abyssal Dragon Blood
abyssal_dragon_prime.description: Red blood from the dragons of the Abyss and the salt-chaos of Tiamat's spilled blood. One drop closes wounds.

abyssal_hound_prime.name: Abyssal Hound Scent Ichor
abyssal_hound_prime.description: Red ichor from the hounds of the Abyss, who track souls across planes. Their noses never fail.

abyssal_mimic_prime.name: Abyssal Mimic Bile
abyssal_mimic_prime.description: Bile from a mimic of the Abyss, the thing that poses as a stair to Hell. It knows a trap from inside.

acid_blob_prime.name: Acid Blob Bladder
acid_blob_prime.description: A yellow-green bladder from an acid blob or grey ooze. It holds acid without dissolving, and teaches you the trick.

adult_blue_dragon_prime.name: Blue Dragon Storm-Scale
adult_blue_dragon_prime.description: A sky-blue scale from the desert dragons that breathe lightning. Sparks still crawl over it.

ammit_spawn_prime.name: Ammit Leg
ammit_spawn_prime.description: A leg from Ammit, the Devourer of the Dead, part crocodile, part lion, part hippo, and her spawn.

anansi_prime.name: Anansi's Story-Bacon
anansi_prime.description: Streaky bacon from Anansi, the spider who owns all the world's stories. Every rasher tells one.

anubis_guardian_prime.name: Anubis Guardian Weighing Core
anubis_guardian_prime.description: The blue core of a jackal-headed tomb guard, made to weigh hearts with the god's own magic.

apocalypse_herald_prime.name: Apocalypse Herald Ichor
apocalypse_herald_prime.description: Red ichor from the heralds and iron horsemen who ride before the end of the world. Nothing kills them easily.

arachne_prime.name: Arachne's Weaver Steak
arachne_prime.description: A steak from Arachne, the weaver who challenged Athena and became the first spider. Her fingers were the quickest in Greece.

arcane_golem_prime.name: Arcane Golem Mana Core
arcane_golem_prime.description: The blue core that powered a golem built of pure spellwork. It is more mana than crystal.

arch_demon_prime.name: Arch-Demon Hellblood
arch_demon_prime.description: The red, smoking blood of the great lords of the Abyss, who rule through cunning more than claws.

assassin_vine_prime.name: Assassin Vine Stalk
assassin_vine_prime.description: A green stalk from the vines that strangle travellers: assassin vine, musk creeper, thorn slinger and the great vine horror. They regrow from nothing.

asterion_minotaur_prime.name: Calydonian Boar Ham
asterion_minotaur_prime.description: A great ham from the Calydonian Boar, the beast Artemis sent to ravage a kingdom and a whole band of heroes hunted.

astral_horror_prime.name: Astral Horror Dream Sac
astral_horror_prime.description: A sac of thin silver dream-stuff from the horror that drifts between worlds. Spell-casters fight over it.

ba_spirit_prime.name: Ba Spirit Shank
ba_spirit_prime.description: A pale shank bone from the Ba, the bird-headed soul of the Egyptian dead, and from the shades of the Duat. Soul-stuff is spell-stuff.

baba_yaga_prime.name: Baba Yaga Oven-Spark
baba_yaga_prime.description: An ember from the oven in Baba Yaga's hut on chicken legs, the oven she threatens lost children with. Tonight it bakes for you.

balor_lesser_prime.name: Balor Flame Ichor
balor_lesser_prime.description: Burning ichor from a lesser balor, the fire demon with the whip of flame. Fire is its home, and it lends you the key.

banshee_prime.name: Banshee Keening Shank
banshee_prime.description: A shank bone from a banshee, the spirit who wails before a death. She knows when doom is near.

basilisk_prime.name: Basilisk Tail Steak
basilisk_prime.description: A green-skinned tail steak from the basilisk, whose gaze turns men to stone. Its flesh fights the stiffening.

bat_prime.name: Giant Bat Drumette
bat_prime.description: A purple drumette from a giant bat, which hears its way through the dark.

behir_lesser_prime.name: Behir Lightning Roll
behir_lesser_prime.description: A blue roll from a behir, the many-legged lightning serpent. It crackles when cut.

beholder_prime.name: Beholder Eyestalk Bulb
beholder_prime.description: One of the little eyes off a beholder's stalks, still glaring. Every spell it ever cast has soaked into it.

black_pudding_prime.name: Black Pudding Sac
black_pudding_prime.description: A dark sac from the black pudding, the ooze that eats metal. Fried, it really is a black pudding.

blink_dog_prime.name: Blink Dog Loin
blink_dog_prime.description: A blue loin from the blink dogs, who teleport in short hops to dodge their enemies.

boggart_prime.name: Boggart Hearth-Ember
boggart_prime.description: An ember-glow in an acorn cup, from the house-spirit gone bad. It keeps the kitchen warm and the pot full.

bone_colossus_prime.name: Bone Colossus Femur
bone_colossus_prime.description: A femur the size of a tree trunk, from the bone colossi and giant skeletons built of whole graveyards.

bone_devil_prime.name: Devil's Bone-Brine
bone_devil_prime.description: The briny ichor of the devils of Hell's ranks, from the lowly lemure to the barbed and the bone devil. Promotion in Hell is by strength.

bone_golem_prime.name: Bone Golem Rune-Cube
bone_golem_prime.description: The rune-cube from a bone golem's skull. It holds a body together when spells try to stop it.

bone_witch_prime.name: Bone Witch Wand-Bone
bone_witch_prime.description: A purple wand-bone from a bone witch, who carves her spells into her own bones.

bugbear_prime.name: Bugbear Bangers
bugbear_prime.description: Fat bangers from a bugbear's den. Bugbears are lazy ambushers with big appetites.

bullywug_prime.name: Bullywug Frog-Leg Sausage
bullywug_prime.description: A coil of frog-leg sausage from the bullywugs, the frog-folk of the marshes.

burning_skeleton_prime.name: Burning Skeleton Ember Marrow
burning_skeleton_prime.description: A glowing lump of marrow that kept a skeleton burning. Its fire cannot hurt you now.

cacus_prime.name: Cacus Stolen-Cattle Links
cacus_prime.description: Sausages from the cattle Cacus the fire-breathing giant stole from Heracles and dragged backwards into his cave.

camazotz_prime.name: Camazotz Bat-God Ichor
camazotz_prime.description: Violet ichor from Camazotz, the death-bat god of the Maya, who rules the House of Bats. He sees everything in the dark.

carbuncle_prime.name: Carbuncle Jewel Steak
carbuncle_prime.description: A steak from the carbuncle, the little beast with a glowing jewel in its head. The jewel's glow is all through the meat.

carrion_crawler_prime.name: Carrion Crawler Steak
carrion_crawler_prime.description: A green-shelled steak from the carrion crawler, the scavenger of the deep. It eats well, so it is meaty.

cath_palug_prime.name: Cath Palug Steak
cath_palug_prime.description: A purple steak from the Cath Palug, the monstrous cat King Arthur fought. Cats always land on their feet.

catoblepas_prime.name: Catoblepas Rump Steak
catoblepas_prime.description: A rump steak from the catoblepas, the heavy-headed buffalo of the swamps, and its cousin the bonnacon. Thick, red and mending.

cave_bear_prime.name: Cave Bear Steak
cave_bear_prime.description: A thick steak from a cave or dire bear. A bear sleeps all winter on what it eats in autumn.

cerberus_prime.name: Cerberus Steak
cerberus_prime.description: A grey steak from Cerberus, the three-headed hound of the gates of Hades. Nothing scares the guard dog of death.

changeling_prime.name: Changeling Glamour Acorn
changeling_prime.description: An acorn cup of the glamour a changeling wears to look like a stolen child. A little of it blurs where you stand.

chaos_troll_prime.name: Chaos Troll Mutant Sausage
chaos_troll_prime.description: A green coil from a troll twisted by chaos magic. It regrows even faster than other trolls.

charybdis_prime.name: Charybdis Gulping Shank
charybdis_prime.description: A great blue shank from Charybdis herself, who drinks the sea three times a day.

charybdis_spawn_prime.name: Charybdis Spawn Shank
charybdis_spawn_prime.description: A blue shank from a spawn of Charybdis, the whirlpool that swallows ships. It swallows hunger, too.

chimera_prime.name: Chimera Triple Steak
chimera_prime.description: A purple steak from the chimera, lion, goat and serpent in one, that breathes fire.

clay_golem_prime.name: Clay Golem Amber Heart
clay_golem_prime.description: The amber heart from a clay golem, the guardian a rabbi shapes and writes alive. It knits torn clay, and torn flesh.

clockwork_horror_prime.name: Clockwork Horror Cog Crystal
clockwork_horror_prime.description: The amber crystal that drove a clockwork horror's gears. It ticks in your head like a busy thought.

cloud_giant_prime.name: Cloud Giant Sky Ham
cloud_giant_prime.description: A blue ham from the cloud giants who live in castles above the sky. Light, airy and lofty.

cobra_prime.name: Cobra Tail Steak
cobra_prime.description: A green-skinned tail steak from a cobra, the fastest striker in the reeds.

cockatrice_prime.name: Cockatrice Drumstick
cockatrice_prime.description: A drumstick from the cockatrice, the rooster-serpent whose touch petrifies. Cooked right, it does the opposite.

corrupted_angel_prime.name: Fallen Angel Halo Mote
corrupted_angel_prime.description: A spark of the halo a fallen angel could not put out. It burns warm and heals deep.

corrupted_treant_prime.name: Treant Rot-Acorn
corrupted_treant_prime.description: A green glow in an acorn cup from a corrupted treant, the ancient tree turned against the forest. Still full of life.

cow_king_prime.name: Cow King's Royal Bacon
cow_king_prime.description: Bacon from the Cow King himself. Kneel.

crypt_thing_prime.name: Crypt Thing Shank
crypt_thing_prime.description: A shank bone from the crypt thing, the polite skeleton that teleports grave-robbers away. The magic is in the bone.

crystal_ooze_prime.name: Crystal Ooze Glitter Sac
crystal_ooze_prime.description: A blue sac from the ooze that looks like a puddle of water, glittering with crystals of mana.

cyclops_prime.name: Cyclops Mutton Links
cyclops_prime.description: Mutton sausages from the cyclops flocks, like the sheep Odysseus hid under. Fat, herby and filling.

darkmantle_prime.name: Darkmantle Mantle Steak
darkmantle_prime.description: A slab of the cloak-shaped flesh that drops from cave ceilings and smothers torches. Thick, fatty and very filling.

death_dog_prime.name: Death Dog Smoked Loin
death_dog_prime.description: A smoked loin from the two-headed death dog, the brother of Cerberus. Two heads, twice the healing.

death_knight_prime.name: Death Knight Shinbone
death_knight_prime.description: A purple shinbone from a death knight, a fallen paladin bound to his armour.

death_lord_prime.name: Death Lord Scepter-Bone
death_lord_prime.description: A purple bone from a death lord, ruler of the undead legions. It hums with necromancy.

death_mage_prime.name: Necromancer's Knucklebone
death_mage_prime.description: A purple knucklebone from the necromancers who outlived their own deaths, from the pale master to the crypt summoner. They study death very closely.

deep_one_priest_prime.name: Deep-One Brine Sac
deep_one_priest_prime.description: A brine sac from a priest of the drowned cities, swollen with sea-prayer. Salty, cold, and humming with old magic.

demon_knight_prime.name: Demon Knight War Ichor
demon_knight_prime.description: Red ichor from the armoured knights and generals of the Abyss. War is what it is made of.

demonic_trickster_prime.name: Rakshasa Trick Ichor
demonic_trickster_prime.description: Violet ichor from the tricksters of the Abyss and the rakshasas of India, who live by illusion.

dire_lion_prime.name: Dire Lion Leg
dire_lion_prime.description: A leg from the dire lion, the great maned hunter of the old plains. Lion meat mends a fighter.

displacer_beast_prime.name: Displacer Beast Steak
displacer_beast_prime.description: A purple steak from the panther that always looks a step from where it is. A little of its trick stays with you.

dracolich_prime.name: Dracolich Knucklebone
dracolich_prime.description: A purple knucklebone from an undead dragon that refused to stay dead. It keeps what it has, forever.

drake_fire_prime.name: Drake Ember-Scale
drake_fire_prime.description: A glowing scale from the fire and frost drakes, the little cousins of dragons. It holds heat like a hearthstone.

draugr_prime.name: Draugr Grave-Bone
draugr_prime.description: A green bone from a draugr, the swollen Norse dead who grow huge in their mounds, and Hel's handmaids.

dretch_prime.name: Dretch Swill Bile
dretch_prime.description: Bile from the lowest, laziest demons of the Abyss, who eat anything and complain the whole time. Filling, foul and plentiful.

dryad_guardian_prime.name: Dryad Heart-Acorn
dryad_guardian_prime.description: A green glow from a dryad's tree-heart. Living wood mends itself, and so will you.

dullahan_spawn_prime.name: Dullahan Black Knucklebone
dullahan_spawn_prime.description: A black knucklebone from the headless rider. A man who eats it is as fearless as a rider with no head to lose.

each_uisce_prime.name: Each Uisce Tide-Mote
each_uisce_prime.description: A blue spark from the each uisce, the water-horse of the Highlands that drags riders into lochs.

earth_elemental_prime.name: Earth Elemental Bedrock Jar
earth_elemental_prime.description: The dense, swirling heart of an earth elemental, with the weight of a mountain.

echidna_prime.name: Echidna Serpent Steak
echidna_prime.description: A purple steak from Echidna, half woman, half serpent, the mother of monsters. Mothers mend.

entropy_elemental_prime.name: Entropy Elemental Unmaking Jar
entropy_elemental_prime.description: A jar of the purple churn of entropy, the end of all things. Magic unravels around it.

erinyes_lesser_prime.name: Erinyes Fury Ichor
erinyes_lesser_prime.description: Ichor from the Furies, who hunt the guilty to the ends of the earth. They never lose a trail.

erlking_prime.name: Erlking's Mist-Acorn
erlking_prime.description: A green glow from the Erlking, the elf-king who rides in the mist and calls children away. Mist and magic.

ethereal_filcher_prime.name: Ethereal Filcher Ectoplasm
ethereal_filcher_prime.description: The blue ectoplasm of the thief that steps between worlds to pick pockets. Nimble fingers in a jelly.

fenrir_pup_prime.name: Fenrir's Pup Shank
fenrir_pup_prime.description: A purple shank from a whelp of Fenrir, the wolf who will swallow the sun. Even the pups are terrible.

fetch_prime.name: Fetch Femur
fetch_prime.description: A long femur from a fetch, the double that appears before a death. It knows danger before it comes.

fionn_hound_prime.name: Fionn's Hound Leg
fionn_hound_prime.description: A leg from the hounds of Fionn mac Cumhaill, the best hunting dogs in Ireland.

fire_beetle_prime.name: Fire Beetle Glow-Leg
fire_beetle_prime.description: An orange leg from a fire beetle, with the glow gland still lit. Miners carry them as lamps.

fire_elemental_prime.name: Bottled Wildfire
fire_elemental_prime.description: The living flame of a fire elemental, trapped in glass. It teaches your body to shrug off flame.

fire_giant_prime.name: Fire Giant Smoked Links
fire_giant_prime.description: Sausages smoked over the forges of the fire giants of Muspelheim. Fire does not hurt the cooks.

flesh_colossus_prime.name: Flesh Colossus Ember-Marrow
flesh_colossus_prime.description: A glowing lump of marrow from a flesh colossus, a giant sewn from many bodies. It burns with life.

flesh_golem_prime.name: Flesh Golem Spark Heart
flesh_golem_prime.description: The amber heart that the lightning kept beating in a stitched-together golem. Grisly, and very good at mending.

fomorian_prime.name: Fomorian Sea-Giant Sausage
fomorian_prime.description: A green coil from a Fomorian, the sea-giants of Ireland who fought the gods. Salty, savage and mending.

frost_crawler_prime.name: Frost Crawler Loin
frost_crawler_prime.description: A blue loin from a frost crawler, the many-legged hunter of icy tunnels. Cold-weather meat, rich with fat.

frost_giant_prime.name: Frost Giant Rime Ham
frost_giant_prime.description: A blue rime-crusted ham from the frost giants of Jotunheim, who live in endless winter.

frost_skeleton_prime.name: Frost Skeleton Rime-Jelly
frost_skeleton_prime.description: The blue rime-jelly that kept a skeleton frozen and walking. It keeps the cold out.

gas_spore_prime.name: Gas Spore Bladder
gas_spore_prime.description: The pale bladder of a gas spore, the floating fungus that explodes. Emptied and boiled, it is very filling.

gelatinous_cube_prime.name: Gelatinous Cube Aspic Sac
gelatinous_cube_prime.description: A pale sac of jelly from a gelatinous cube, the transparent block that sweeps the corridors clean.

ghoul_prime.name: Ghoul Gnawed Bone
ghoul_prime.description: A green, gnawed bone from the ghouls and ghasts whose claws paralyse. Their own bones fight the stiffening.

giant_beetle_prime.name: Giant Beetle Shell-Loin
giant_beetle_prime.description: A blue shell-loin from a giant or death beetle. Under the armour is soft, mending meat.

giant_centipede_prime.name: Giant Centipede Steak
giant_centipede_prime.description: A steak from a giant centipede. A hundred legs make a lot of meat.

giant_frog_prime.name: Giant Frog Leg Roll
giant_frog_prime.description: A green-skinned roll of giant frog leg, the classic adventurer's supper.

giant_lizard_prime.name: Giant Lizard Tail Medallion
giant_lizard_prime.description: A medallion of tail from a giant lizard or komodo. Lizards regrow their tails; the meat mends you.

giant_mantis_prime.name: Mantis Steak
giant_mantis_prime.description: A green-skinned steak from a giant mantis, the fastest strike in the insect world.

giant_rat_prime.name: Giant Rat Rump
giant_rat_prime.description: A green-skinned rump steak from a giant or dire rat. Everyone's first meal in the dungeon.

giant_scorpion_prime.name: Scorpion Claw-Leg
giant_scorpion_prime.description: A red claw-leg from a giant scorpion, and from the scorpion-men who guard the sunrise.

giant_spider_prime.name: Giant Spider Leg
giant_spider_prime.description: A purple leg from the giant spiders, cave spiders, web-spinners, ettercaps and spider queens. Spiders shrug off their own venom.

giant_wasp_prime.name: Giant Wasp Leg
giant_wasp_prime.description: An orange leg from a giant wasp, the fastest thing in the dungeon air.

gibbering_mouther_prime.name: Gibbering Mouther Gut Sac
gibbering_mouther_prime.description: A stomach from the blob of mouths that never stops eating or talking. It holds a frightening amount of food.

gilded_mimic_prime.name: Gilded Mimic Gold Heart
gilded_mimic_prime.description: The hard golden heart of a mimic that passed itself off as a treasure chest. It still tingles when a lie walks near.

glabrezu_prime.name: Glabrezu Wish Ichor
glabrezu_prime.description: Violet ichor from the pincered demons who grant wishes, always with a catch. Their blood is pure temptation, and pure mana.

gnoll_prime.name: Gnoll Hyena Links
gnoll_prime.description: Hyena-meat sausages from the gnolls, the laughing pack-hunters of Yeenoghu. They eat everything, always.

goblin_king_prime.name: Goblin King's Royal Sausage
goblin_king_prime.description: A green coil of sausage from the goblin king's own table, the best his thieves could steal.

goblin_prime.name: Goblin Gristle
goblin_prime.description: A cured leg of goblin, which is mostly gristle and grudges. Stewed long enough it goes tender, and it stretches a pot further than it has any right to.

gorgon_warrior_prime.name: Gorgon Bull Rune-Block
gorgon_warrior_prime.description: A rune-cut block from the bronze bull of the gorgon's guard, which breathes petrifying gas. Its runes keep a body from stiffening.

grave_guardian_prime.name: Tomb Guardian Marrow Plug
grave_guardian_prime.description: A plug of marrow from the guardians of tombs, who were bound never to be fooled.

gravehound_prime.name: Gravehound Marrow Coin
gravehound_prime.description: A coin of marrow from the hounds that sniff out graves. Their noses never fail.

green_slime_prime.name: Green Slime Sac
green_slime_prime.description: A green sac from the slime that turns everything it touches into more slime. Its growth becomes your healing.

grell_prime.name: Grell Lightning Bladder
grell_prime.description: The floating bladder that keeps a grell aloft and twitching. Its quickness gets into your hands.

grick_prime.name: Grick Tentacle Roll
grick_prime.description: A green-skinned tentacle roll from a grick, the worm with a beak. Its rubbery brain is surprisingly clever.

grid_bug_prime.name: Grid Bug Spark Sac
grid_bug_prime.description: A purple sac from a grid bug, the little bug that can only move in straight lines. Oddly logical.

griffin_prime.name: Griffin Drumstick
griffin_prime.description: A drumstick from the eagle-lion that guards gold. It is all lion where it counts, and lion meat mends.

harpy_prime.name: Harpy Wing Ham
harpy_prime.description: A smoked wing joint from the shrieking bird-women. Tough, greasy and better than it has any right to be.

hecate_hound_prime.name: Hecate's Hound Steak
hecate_hound_prime.description: A purple steak from the black hounds of Hecate, goddess of crossroads, who bay at the moon. Dark, rich and filling.

hell_bovine_prime.name: Hell Bovine Sirloin
hell_bovine_prime.description: A sirloin from a bovine of the secret pastures. Moo.

hezrou_prime.name: Hezrou Toad Venom
hezrou_prime.description: Green venom from the toad demons of the swamps of the Abyss, whose stench sickens armies. Your body learns to ignore it.

hill_giant_prime.name: Hill Giant Ham Hock
hill_giant_prime.description: A huge ham hock from a hill giant's larder. Hill giants eat whole sheep, and they cure their hams well.

hobgoblin_prime.name: Hobgoblin Ration Sausage
hobgoblin_prime.description: A coil of the hard ration sausage every hobgoblin soldier carries. Dense, dull and built to last.

hollow_one_prime.name: Hollow One Marrow Disc
hollow_one_prime.description: A marrow disc from the empty husks of the dead. Hollow, but there is a surprising amount of marrow.

homunculus_prime.name: Homunculus Spark Core
homunculus_prime.description: The little crystal that kept a wizard's homunculus alive. It hums with borrowed magic.

hook_horror_prime.name: Hook Horror Steak
hook_horror_prime.description: A steak from the hook horror, the clacking beaked hunter of the deep caves. It thinks in echoes.

huecuva_prime.name: Huecuva Marrow Wheel
huecuva_prime.description: A wheel of marrow from a huecuva, a false priest raised as a skeleton in his robes. He learned humility too late.

hugin_raven_prime.name: Huginn Raven Breast Roll
hugin_raven_prime.description: A rolled dark breast from one of Odin's ravens, who fly over the world each day and see it all.

hydra_prime.name: Hydra Neck Roll
hydra_prime.description: A green-skinned neck from the hydra. Cut one off and two grow back. Eat one and you heal the same way.

ice_elemental_prime.name: Bottled Blizzard
ice_elemental_prime.description: The swirling snow-heart of an ice elemental, sealed in a jar. Frost stops reaching past your skin.

ice_troll_prime.name: Ice Troll Frost Ham
ice_troll_prime.description: A blue, frost-rimed ham from an ice troll. Troll flesh mends itself, even frozen.

imp_prime.name: Imp Brimstone Ichor
imp_prime.description: Ember-red blood from the little winged devils that run errands for wizards. Familiars are made of magic, and so is their blood.

incubus_prime.name: Dream-Thief Ichor
incubus_prime.description: Violet ichor from the demons that walk in dreams, the empusa among them. Drunk carefully, it teaches you to tell a dream from a lie.

iron_golem_prime.name: Iron Golem Rune-Heart
iron_golem_prime.description: The iron heart of a golem that poison and fire cannot touch. It hardens the skin like plate.

iron_sentinel_prime.name: Sentinel Watch-Cube
iron_sentinel_prime.description: The rune-cube that kept an iron sentinel awake for a thousand years. It does not let you miss anything.

jiangshi_prime.name: Jiangshi Hopping Shank
jiangshi_prime.description: A shank bone from the jiangshi, the stiff hopping dead of China, kept moving by stolen breath. That breath is magic.

jormungandr_juvenile_prime.name: Jormungandr Juvenile Steak
jormungandr_juvenile_prime.description: A steak from a juvenile World Serpent, not yet big enough to circle the earth. Thick and enormous.

jormungandr_spawn_prime.name: Jormungandr Spawn Steak
jormungandr_spawn_prime.description: A green-skinned steak from a spawn of the World Serpent. It carries the old serpent's slow, deep thoughts.

kobold_prime.name: Kobold Tail Sausage
kobold_prime.description: A coil of sausage from the kobolds, the little dragon-worshippers who set traps everywhere. Quick hands made it.

kuo_toa_prime.name: Kuo-Toa Brined Ham
kuo_toa_prime.description: A blue-brined ham from the fish-men of the underground seas. Smells fishy; fills you up.

kusarikku_prime.name: Kusarikku Bull-Man Links
kusarikku_prime.description: Sausages from the bull-men who guarded the gates of the Sun god in Babylon. Stubborn and sturdy.

lahamu_prime.name: Lahamu Silt Sac
lahamu_prime.description: A silt-heavy sac from Lahamu, the hairy serpent of the first sea. The mud of creation is still in it.

lamia_prime.name: Lamia Serpent Sausage
lamia_prime.description: A purple ring sausage from the lamia, the serpent-queen of old Libya who charms travellers. Sweet and spellbinding.

leprechaun_prime.name: Leprechaun Luck-Acorn
leprechaun_prime.description: An acorn cup of green glow from a leprechaun's hoard. It is filling and, they say, lucky.

lesser_death_prime.name: Lesser Death's Scythe-Bone
lesser_death_prime.description: A black bone from a lesser death, the reaper's apprentice. Nothing more can be taken from you.

lich_prime.name: Lich Frost-Bone
lich_prime.description: A pale blue bone from the liches, wizards who traded life for power, from the lowliest thrall to the arch-lich. Pure necromantic mana.

lindworm_prime.name: Lindworm Coil-Scale
lindworm_prime.description: A green scale from the wingless lindworm that coils around hills. The beast can squeeze a castle; the scale makes you sturdy.

lizardfolk_prime.name: Lizardfolk Smoked Haunch
lizardfolk_prime.description: A smoked haunch from a lizardfolk hunting party. Lizardfolk smoke everything they catch, and they catch a lot.

locust_swarmlord_prime.name: Locust Swarmlord Drumstick
locust_swarmlord_prime.description: A drumstick from the lord of the locust swarms that eat whole countries bare. Crunchy, rich and endless.

lurker_above_prime.name: Lurker Ambush Sac
lurker_above_prime.description: A broad flat sac from the hunters that hang on ceilings and drop on whole parties. It is mostly digestive juice, and filling.

lurking_horror_prime.name: Lurking Horror Dread Gland
lurking_horror_prime.description: The gland that makes a lurking horror's victims feel watched. Eaten, it tells you when something watches you.

magma_elemental_prime.name: Jarred Magma
magma_elemental_prime.description: The molten heart of a magma or lava elemental, swirling orange. It makes you as at home in fire as it was.

manticore_prime.name: Manticore Leg
manticore_prime.description: A leg from the manticore, the man-faced lion with a tail of spikes. Lion meat, mostly.

marilith_spawn_prime.name: Marilith Serpent Ichor
marilith_spawn_prime.description: Red ichor from the six-armed serpent-women of the Abyss, who fight with six swords at once.

medusa_prime.name: Medusa Snake-Hair Links
medusa_prime.description: Little sausages from the snake-hair of the gorgons. Yes, really. Athena gave Medusa's blood the power to heal and to kill.

mimic_prime.name: Mimic Glue Gland
mimic_prime.description: The gland that makes a mimic's lid stick to greedy hands. Boiled down, it is the stickiest, most filling jelly in the dungeon.

mind_flayer_prime.name: Mind Flayer Brain Pouch
mind_flayer_prime.description: The rubbery sac a mind flayer stores stolen thoughts in. A cook who eats it remembers things he never learned.

minotaur_prime.name: Minotaur Bull Ham
minotaur_prime.description: A great ham from the bull-headed warriors of the labyrinth. Pure, raging muscle.

mohrg_prime.name: Mohrg Ribbone
mohrg_prime.description: A green rib from a mohrg, the skeleton of a murderer with a long, darting tongue. Quick and nasty.

moss_sentinel_prime.name: Moss Sentinel Mossy Core
moss_sentinel_prime.description: A green rune-core overgrown with moss, from the sentinel that guards forgotten groves.

mud_crawler_prime.name: Mud Crawler Leg
mud_crawler_prime.description: A muddy leg from the mud crawlers of the marsh. Washed well, it is good plain food.

mummy_prime.name: Mummy Linen-Shank
mummy_prime.description: A linen-wrapped shank from a mummy, preserved for thousands of years. Nothing has been taken from it in all that time.

myconid_worker_prime.name: Myconid Stalk
myconid_worker_prime.description: A purple-hearted stalk from the mushroom folk, workers and sovereigns. A whole colony grows from it.

naga_guardian_prime.name: Naga Tail Roll
naga_guardian_prime.description: A green-skinned tail roll from the naga, serpent guardians of temples and treasures, and the brood of the naga-king Takshaka.

nalfeshnee_lesser_prime.name: Nalfeshnee Judgement Ichor
nalfeshnee_lesser_prime.description: Golden ichor from the demon-judges who sentence souls in the Abyss. It weighs things clearly.

nemean_lion_prime.name: Nemean Lion Leg
nemean_lion_prime.description: A leg from the Nemean lion and the lionesses of Sekhmet, whose hides no blade could cut.

nidhogg_brood_prime.name: Nidhoggr Brood Root-Scale
nidhogg_brood_prime.description: A violet scale from the brood of the dragon that gnaws the roots of the World Tree. It knows the secrets in the roots.

night_hag_prime.name: Night Hag Nightmare Mote
night_hag_prime.description: A violet spark from the hags, who ride sleepers' chests and steal dreams. It is the stuff of magic.

nightwing_prime.name: Nightwing Void-Marrow
nightwing_prime.description: Dark marrow with a white heart, from the nightwing, the bat-shape of the void that blots out the stars.

nosferatu_prime.name: Nosferatu Blood-Marrow
nosferatu_prime.description: Glowing blood-marrow from a nosferatu, the plague-rat vampire. It restores what was lost.

nothic_prime.name: Nothic Weird-Eye
nothic_prime.description: The single huge eye of a nothic, the cursed wizard that sees secrets. It sees through what is hidden, even fried.

nue_prime.name: Nue Drumstick
nue_prime.description: A purple drumstick from the nue of Japan: monkey face, tiger legs, snake tail, and a cry that brings thunder. Strange magic runs in it.

ochre_jelly_prime.name: Ochre Jelly Sac
ochre_jelly_prime.description: An orange sac from the ochre jelly, which creeps under doors to feed. It is mostly food.

ogre_prime.name: Ogre Bangers
ogre_prime.description: A string of greasy bangers from the ogres, two-headed or not. Ogres eat a lot; so do their sausages.

orc_warrior_prime.name: Orc Salted Haunch
orc_warrior_prime.description: A dark, salt-hard haunch carried by the orc warbands, from scout to warlord. It keeps for months and fills a soldier for days.

ossuary_horror_prime.name: Ossuary Marrow
ossuary_horror_prime.description: Marrow from the bone heaps of the ossuary horrors and bone collectors, who build themselves from many dead.

otyugh_prime.name: Otyugh Iron Stomach
otyugh_prime.description: The stomach of the garbage-eater of the sewers, which can digest anything. Eat it and so, for a while, can you.

owlbear_prime.name: Owlbear Steak
owlbear_prime.description: A steak from the owlbear, half owl, half bear, all bad temper. Bear meat mends.

pazuzu_spawn_prime.name: Pazuzu Wind Ichor
pazuzu_spawn_prime.description: Ichor from the brood of Pazuzu, king of the wind demons of Babylon. Cold, dry and very clever.

pegasus_prime.name: Pegasus Drumstick
pegasus_prime.description: A drumstick from a winged horse gone wild in the dark. It tastes of high clean air and mends like a long rest.

peryton_prime.name: Peryton Stag-Bird Loin
peryton_prime.description: A loin from the peryton, the stag with wings that casts a man's shadow. Rich, dark game meat that fills a hunter up.

phase_spider_prime.name: Phase Spider Leg
phase_spider_prime.description: A purple leg from a phase spider, which blinks in and out of this world as it hunts.

piercer_prime.name: Piercer Drip Gland
piercer_prime.description: An orange drip gland from a piercer, the stalactite that drops on people. It hangs still and watches.

pit_fiend_spawn_prime.name: Pit Fiend Ichor
pit_fiend_spawn_prime.description: Red ichor from the pit fiends, the generals of Hell, whose wounds close as fast as they are made.

pixie_swarm_prime.name: Pixie Dust Mote
pixie_swarm_prime.description: A spark of the dust a pixie swarm leaves behind. Fairy dust is the oldest magic there is.

plague_ooze_prime.name: Plague Ooze Bladder
plague_ooze_prime.description: A yellow-green bladder from the ooze that carries plague. Survive it and plague cannot catch you.

poltergeist_prime.name: Poltergeist Marrow Round
poltergeist_prime.description: A marrow round from the bones a poltergeist throws around. The restless magic that moved them is still inside.

puca_prime.name: Puca Shapeshift Mote
puca_prime.description: A violet spark from the púca, the shape-changer of Irish hills, horse one night, goat the next.

ra_serpent_prime.name: Ra's Serpent Sun-Joint
ra_serpent_prime.description: An orange joint from the serpents of Ra, warmed by the sun god's own light. Sunlight heals.

rangda_prime.name: Rangda's Witch-Queen Ichor
rangda_prime.description: Violet ichor from Rangda, the witch-queen of Bali, forever at war with the lion Barong. She knows every curse.

ravanas_arm_prime.name: Ravana's Arm Ichor
ravanas_arm_prime.description: Red ichor from one of the twenty arms of Ravana, the ten-headed demon king of Lanka. Each arm could lift a mountain.

redcap_prime.name: Redcap Ember-Acorn
redcap_prime.description: An ember-glow from the cap the redcap dips in blood to keep it red. Fierce and hot.

revenant_prime.name: Revenant Thighbone
revenant_prime.description: A thighbone from a revenant, a dead man come back for revenge. It never gives up.

roc_chick_prime.name: Roc Drumstick
roc_chick_prime.description: A drumstick from a roc, the bird that carries off elephants. Even a chick's leg is the size of a man's.

rock_python_prime.name: Rock Python Tail Joint
rock_python_prime.description: A joint from the thick tail of a rock python, which swallows a goat whole. A python eats once a month, and after this so could you.

roper_prime.name: Roper Lure Bladder
roper_prime.description: The pale bladder behind a roper's single eye, the stalagmite that hunts with sticky strands. It notices everything.

rot_grub_swarm_prime.name: Rot Grub Drumstick
rot_grub_swarm_prime.description: Fat grubs pressed onto a bone and roasted, the khrafstra and rot grubs that crawl in the dungeon's rubbish. Disgusting. Filling.

ruinous_djinn_prime.name: Djinn Sandstorm Jar
ruinous_djinn_prime.description: A jar of the whirling sand a ruinous djinn rides. The wind in it makes you quick.

rust_monster_prime.name: Rust Monster Rust Gland
rust_monster_prime.description: The gland a rust monster uses to turn a sword to red flakes. Cooked, it leaves your skin and gear oddly hard to corrode.

sable_serpent_prime.name: Sable Serpent Smoked Roll
sable_serpent_prime.description: A black, smoked roll from the sable serpent, which hunts by heat in total darkness.

satyr_warrior_prime.name: Satyr Wine-Acorn
satyr_warrior_prime.description: An acorn cup brimming with the golden glow of a satyr's revels. Wine, song and supper in one.

scarab_swarm_prime.name: Scarab Steak
scarab_swarm_prime.description: A green-shelled steak of pressed scarab and khepri beetle, the sacred beetles of Egypt that roll the sun.

scylla_prime.name: Scylla Tentacle Roll
scylla_prime.description: A blue tentacle roll from Scylla, the six-headed sea-monster of the narrow strait.

sea_dragon_spawn_prime.name: Sea Dragon Tide-Scale
sea_dragon_spawn_prime.description: A blue scale from a young sea dragon. The tides and the moon pulled it, and their pull is magic.

sea_serpent_norse_prime.name: Sea Serpent Loin Roll
sea_serpent_norse_prime.description: A blue loin roll from a Norse sea serpent, the kind that wraps longships in its coils.

sea_snake_prime.name: Sea Snake Fillet Roll
sea_snake_prime.description: A blue fillet roll from the sea snakes and swamp serpents. Clean sea meat that mends.

seal_demon_death_prime.name: Samael's Death Ichor
seal_demon_death_prime.description: Pale ichor from Samael, Demon of Death, the angel who takes the last breath. He takes nothing from you now.

seal_demon_earthquake_prime.name: Beleth's Quake Ichor
seal_demon_earthquake_prime.description: Golden ichor from Beleth, Demon of the Earthquake, whose horses make the ground tremble. It steadies your own ground.

seal_demon_famine_prime.name: Mammon's Famine Ichor
seal_demon_famine_prime.description: Golden ichor from Mammon, Demon of Famine, who hoards bread while the world starves. Now his hoard is yours.

seal_demon_pestilence_prime.name: Buer's Plague Ichor
seal_demon_pestilence_prime.description: Green ichor from Buer, Demon of Pestilence, who knows every herb and every plague. Drink it and plague passes you by.

seal_demon_silence_prime.name: Abyzou's Silence Ichor
seal_demon_silence_prime.description: Pale ichor from Abyzou, Demon of Silence, the last seal. The words she stole are all still inside.

seal_demon_war_prime.name: Bael's War Ichor
seal_demon_war_prime.description: Red ichor from Bael, Demon of War, the first king of Hell. Every battle ever fought is in it.

seal_demon_wrath_prime.name: Amon's Wrath Ichor
seal_demon_wrath_prime.description: Ichor from Amon, Demon of Wrath, first of the seven seals. Rage boils in it.

sets_jackal_prime.name: Set's Jackal Steak
sets_jackal_prime.description: A steak from the jackal-beast of Set, god of the desert storm. It sees through sandstorms.

shade_prime.name: Shade Gloom-Jelly
shade_prime.description: The blue jelly a shade leaves as it fades, cold and dim. Night opens to anyone who eats it.

shadow_demon_prime.name: Shadow Demon Smoke Ichor
shadow_demon_prime.description: The smoky blood of a demon made of darkness. Drink it and darkness stops hiding things from you.

shadow_prime.name: Shadow Gloom-Ectoplasm
shadow_prime.description: The blue ectoplasm of a living shadow, the kind that steals strength. It slips through fingers.

shambling_mound_prime.name: Shambling Mound Compost Jar
shambling_mound_prime.description: A jar of the rich, rotten heart of a shambling mound. Everything grows in it, including you.

shield_guardian_prime.name: Shield Guardian Ward Core
shield_guardian_prime.description: The warding crystal from a shield guardian, built to take blows meant for its master. It still wants to protect someone.

skeleton_prime.name: Skeleton Marrow Slice
skeleton_prime.description: A slice of marrow bone from the dungeon's endless skeletons, archers, mages and dancers alike. There is always more.

sluagh_prime.name: Sluagh Wing-Bone
sluagh_prime.description: A purple wing-bone from the Sluagh, the host of the restless dead that flies in flocks from the west.

sobek_warrior_prime.name: Sobek Crocodile Sausage
sobek_warrior_prime.description: A green coil of crocodile sausage from the warriors of Sobek, the crocodile god of the Nile.

soul_eater_prime.name: Soul Eater Hollow Bone
soul_eater_prime.description: A pale blue bone from the soul eaters, and from the Keres who feast on the dying. It still hums with stolen souls.

specter_prime.name: Specter Ectoplasm
specter_prime.description: The cold blue ectoplasm of a specter, a ghost full of hate. The hate boils off; the magic stays.

spectral_dragon_prime.name: Spectral Dragon Ectoplasm
spectral_dragon_prime.description: The glowing blue ectoplasm of a dragon's ghost. All the magic of the living dragon lingers in it.

sphinx_prime.name: Sphinx Lion Steak
sphinx_prime.description: A steak from the sphinxes, who ask riddles and eat those who answer wrong. Clever meat.

spriggan_prime.name: Spriggan Root-Acorn
spriggan_prime.description: A green glow from a spriggan, the little fae that swells to giant size when angry. It makes you tough as a root.

star_spawn_prime.name: Star Spawn Ink Sac
star_spawn_prime.description: The ink sac of a thing that fell from between the stars. The ink is darker than night and full of strange power.

stirge_swarm_prime.name: Stirge Drumstick
stirge_swarm_prime.description: A drumstick from a stirge, the mosquito-bird that drinks blood. It gives back what it took.

stone_giant_prime.name: Stone Giant Rock-Salt Links
stone_giant_prime.description: Sausages cured in rock salt by the stone giants, who live inside mountains. Dense and tough.

stone_golem_prime.name: Stone Golem Rune-Heart
stone_golem_prime.description: The rune-carved heart of a stone golem. Grind a little into soup and your bones feel like granite.

storm_elemental_prime.name: Bottled Thunderhead
storm_elemental_prime.description: A jar of swirling stormcloud from a storm or air elemental. Lightning flickers inside.

storm_giant_prime.name: Storm Giant Thunder Sausage
storm_giant_prime.description: A blue coil from the storm giants, who rule the weather from undersea castles. It crackles in the pan.

strigoi_prime.name: Strigoi Blood-Bone
strigoi_prime.description: An orange bone from a strigoi, the Romanian night-vampire with eyes like coals.

stymphalian_bird_prime.name: Stymphalian Bronze-Feather Drumstick
stymphalian_bird_prime.description: A drumstick from the bronze-feathered birds that Heracles drove off with a rattle. Lean, springy and filling.

talos_prime.name: Talos Bronze Heart
talos_prime.description: The amber-bright heart of Talos, the bronze giant who threw rocks at ships off Crete. Molten strength.

tengu_warrior_prime.name: Tengu Warrior Wing Ham
tengu_warrior_prime.description: A wing joint from the crow-faced swordsmen of the mountains. They are said to have taught swordplay to heroes.

the_sphinx_prime.name: The Sphinx's Riddle Steak
the_sphinx_prime.description: A steak from The Sphinx herself, keeper of the riddle of the ages. Only the wise get to eat it.

thoth_construct_prime.name: Thoth Construct Ink Core
thoth_construct_prime.description: The blue core of a scribe-construct from Thoth's temple, still full of the god's written magic.

thunderbird_lesser_prime.name: Thunderbird Storm Loin
thunderbird_lesser_prime.description: A blue loin from a lesser thunderbird. It still crackles faintly and smells of rain.

titan_prime.name: Titan Haunch
titan_prime.description: A blue haunch from a titan, the elder giants who ruled before the gods. Immense and mending.

troglodyte_prime.name: Troglodyte Musk Haunch
troglodyte_prime.description: A dark haunch from the troglodytes, whose stink makes men retch. Smoke the stink out and it is hearty meat.

troll_prime.name: Troll Gut Sausage
troll_prime.description: A green coil of troll sausage. Troll meat grows back if you leave it, so cooked troll is famous for mending.

ugallu_demon_prime.name: Ugallu Lion-Demon Ichor
ugallu_demon_prime.description: Red ichor from the lion-headed storm demons of Babylon, the guards of the underworld gates.

unicorn_corrupted_prime.name: Corrupted Unicorn Drumstick
unicorn_corrupted_prime.description: A drumstick from a unicorn turned bitter by the dungeon. Even corrupted, its body still fights poison.

valkyrie_shade_prime.name: Valkyrie Spear-Bone
valkyrie_shade_prime.description: A purple bone from the shades of the valkyries and the einherjar, the chosen warriors of Valhalla.

vampire_prime.name: Vampire Knucklebone
vampire_prime.description: A purple knucklebone from the vampires, from the lowest thrall to the ancient lords. A vampire's body heals from almost anything.

violet_fungus_prime.name: Violet Fungus Stalk
violet_fungus_prime.description: A pink-hearted stalk from the violet fungus and the fungal horrors of the deep caves. Spores show you what moves.

void_crawler_prime.name: Void Crawler Ink Bladder
void_crawler_prime.description: A bladder from the crawler that slides between this world and the empty one. Its slipperiness comes with it.

void_elemental_prime.name: Void Elemental Nothing-Jar
void_elemental_prime.description: A jar of the empty dark that a void elemental is made of. Spells fall into it and are lost.

void_leviathan_prime.name: Void Leviathan Blubber Sac
void_leviathan_prime.description: A great sac of blubber from the whale that swims the empty dark. One sac could feed a ship's crew for a week.

void_seraph_prime.name: Void Seraph Ash-Light Ichor
void_seraph_prime.description: Violet ichor from a seraph that fell into the void, still burning with old holy fire gone strange.

void_wyrm_prime.name: Void Wyrm Night-Scale
void_wyrm_prime.description: A violet scale from a wyrm that swims through the empty space between stars. Stars glitter inside it.

vrock_prime.name: Vrock Vulture Bile
vrock_prime.description: Yellow bile from the vulture demons that dance in a ring before they spore their prey. Quick, ugly and effective.

vrykolakas_prime.name: Vrykolakas Warm Bone
vrykolakas_prime.description: A warm bone from a vrykolakas, the Greek vampire that grows fat in its grave. Its marrow restores.

water_elemental_prime.name: Water Elemental Tide Jar
water_elemental_prime.description: The clear, swirling heart of a water elemental, as fresh as a mountain spring. Wounds wash clean in it.

wendigo_prime.name: Wendigo Hunger-Bone
wendigo_prime.description: A pale shank from the wendigo, the spirit of endless hunger. Eat it and it takes your hunger instead.

werebear_prime.name: Werebear Leg
werebear_prime.description: A leg from a werebear, the bear-shifter who guards the woods. Bear-meat mends.

wererat_prime.name: Wererat Streaky Bacon
wererat_prime.description: Streaky bacon from a wererat, the sneak-thief cursed with rat's blood. Greasy and filling.

weretiger_prime.name: Weretiger Leg
weretiger_prime.description: An orange leg from a weretiger, the man who becomes a tiger in the jungle at night.

werewolf_prime.name: Werewolf Moon-Steak
werewolf_prime.description: A steak from a werewolf, alpha or elder. Under the moon a wolf smells and hears everything.

wight_prime.name: Wight Barrow-Femur
wight_prime.description: A femur from the wights of the barrows and cairns, who hoard their grave goods with iron grips.

wild_hunt_captain_prime.name: Wild Hunt Horn-Spark
wild_hunt_captain_prime.description: A bright spark from the captain of the Wild Hunt, which rides the storm across the sky.

will_o_wisp_prime.name: Wisp-Lit Shinbone
will_o_wisp_prime.description: A green-glowing shinbone from the lights that lead travellers into bogs. Their glow is pure marsh-magic.

winter_wolf_prime.name: Winter Wolf Shank
winter_wolf_prime.description: A shank from the winter wolf, which breathes frost and runs on snow. The cold is its home.

wolf_pack_leader_prime.name: Dire Wolf Steak
wolf_pack_leader_prime.description: A steak from the leaders of the wolf packs and the dire wolf alphas. Lean, red and wild.

wood_golem_prime.name: Wood Golem Sap Crystal
wood_golem_prime.description: The hardened sap that once ran a wood golem. It sets a body as steady as an oak.

world_serpent_prime.name: World Serpent Scale
world_serpent_prime.description: A green scale from the World Serpent, whose venom will kill Thor himself. Its scale keeps poison out.

wormwood_blight_prime.name: Wormwood Bitter Ichor
wormwood_blight_prime.description: Green ichor from Wormwood, the bitter blight that turns water to poison. Bitterness sharpens the mind.

wraith_prime.name: Wraith Ectoplasm
wraith_prime.description: The cold blue ectoplasm a wraith leaves behind, thick with the magic that keeps it unliving.

wyrm_prime.name: Wyrm Coil-Scale
wyrm_prime.description: A green scale from the long, quick wyrms that strike like whips. Supple and fast.

wyvern_prime.name: Wyvern Tail-Scale
wyvern_prime.description: A green scale from near a wyvern's sting. The beast carries its own antidote under it.

xorn_prime.name: Xorn Gravel Jar
xorn_prime.description: A jar of the gravel a xorn chews as it swims through stone. Eat a little, and rock feels soft.

yellow_mold_prime.name: Yellow Mold Log
yellow_mold_prime.description: A log thick with yellow mold and the brown mold that drinks heat. Scraped and cooked, it is starchy and filling.

young_black_dragon_prime.name: Black Dragon Bog-Scale
young_black_dragon_prime.description: A dark green scale from a black dragon, the swamp breeder that breathes acid. Acid beads off it.

young_dragon_prime.name: Dragon Heart-Scale
young_dragon_prime.description: A great glowing scale from over a dragon's heart, the toughest armour in the world. It mends the eater like a dragon heals.

young_red_dragon_prime.name: Red Dragon Fire-Scale
young_red_dragon_prime.description: A blood-red scale from the dragons that breathe fire over their hoards. It cannot burn, and neither, for a while, can you.

yuan_ti_pureblood_prime.name: Yuan-Ti Smoked Haunch
yuan_ti_pureblood_prime.description: A smoked haunch from a yuan-ti pureblood's pack, cured in temple smoke. The serpent-folk are sorcerers.

zombie_prime.name: Zombie Shinbone
zombie_prime.description: A green-tinged shinbone from the walking dead, plague-ridden or fresh. Boiled long and hard, the marrow is surprisingly mending.

abaddon_destroyer_trophy.name: Abaddon's Locust Heart
abaddon_destroyer_trophy.description: Eat the locust-heart of the Angel of the Bottomless Pit. The dungeon recognises your apotheosis: every stat permanently increases by 1.

abyssal_kelp.name: Abyssal Kelp
abyssal_kelp.description: Dark kelp from the deep water, thick with minerals. Sailors eat it to heal on long voyages.

altar_incense.name: Altar Incense
altar_incense.description: Sweet incense scraped from an old altar. Burned under a pot, it gives food a calming smoke.

asmodeus_trophy.name: Asmodeus's Pact-Blood
asmodeus_trophy.description: The Prince of Hell signs your contract. Once, when you would die, you don't — the contract is then spent.

asterion_minotaur_trophy.name: Asterion's Horn-Crown
asterion_minotaur_trophy.description: The horn-crown of the Labyrinth's bull. Cooking it answers a calling.

blood_archon_trophy.name: Blood Archon's Heart
blood_archon_trophy.description: Vampiric ascension. +5% lifesteal on all melee attacks, permanently.

cave_mushroom.name: Cave Mushroom
cave_mushroom.description: A fat pale mushroom from damp cave floors. Good in nearly everything.

crystal_shard.name: Crystal Shard
crystal_shard.description: A clear shard from the crystal caves, humming faintly. Wizards grind it into their tea.

deep_iron.name: Deep-Iron Shaving
deep_iron.description: A shaving of the dark iron that grows in the deepest rock. Old smiths swore a pinch in the stew made a man strong.

fafnir_dragon_trophy.name: Fafnir's Heart
fafnir_dragon_trophy.description: Sigurd's reward. Each floor you descend from here, your max HP rises by 2.

fenrir_wolf_trophy.name: Fenrir's Tooth
fenrir_wolf_trophy.description: The strength of the wolf that will devour Odin. +3 STR, permanently.

green_knight_trophy.name: Green Knight's Holly-Bough
green_knight_trophy.description: The beheading-game pact, now yours. Once per run, when you die, revive at 50% HP.

holy_water.name: Holy Water
holy_water.description: Water from an altar spring, blessed long ago. A splash in the pot makes any dish holy.

hrungnirs_ghost_trophy.name: Hrungnir's Stone-Heart
hrungnirs_ghost_trophy.description: The triangular heart Thor shattered, beating in your chest. +2 CON and you cannot be petrified.

medusa_gorgon_trophy.name: Medusa's Blood
medusa_gorgon_trophy.description: Greek folklore truth: gorgon blood is both poison and panacea. You are permanently immune to petrification from any source.

nidhoggr_fragment_trophy.name: Níðhöggr's Scale
nidhoggr_fragment_trophy.description: The world-serpent's scale. Each floor descended: +2 max MP. Also, poison can never take hold of you again, and does you half damage.

river_salt.name: River Salt
river_salt.description: Salt from underground rivers. A ring of salt keeps evil out, and so does a pinch on your food.

starnut.name: Starnut
starnut.description: A hard round nut with star-shaped ridges that glitters in lamplight. It grows only in the deep mines, where the old miners baked it into tarts, and the little cave folk still love it.

sunroot.name: Sunroot
sunroot.description: A bright orange-gold root with feathery green tops, sweet as honey. The great running birds of the Underway will cross a cavern for one.

surtur_trophy.name: Surtur's Ember
surtur_trophy.description: A coal from Lævateinn. Fire does you half damage and can never set you alight, permanently.

swamp_moss.name: Swamp Moss
swamp_moss.description: A clump of green swamp moss, used for centuries to bind wounds. Cooked, it mends from the inside.

tiamat_trophy.name: Tiamat's Chromatic Tear
tiamat_trophy.description: One tear from her five mourning eyes. Cold, fire, lightning, acid and poison hurt you about a fifth less — permanently.

whispering_crone_trophy.name: Whispering Crone's Tongue
whispering_crone_trophy.description: Norn-tier prophecy. +2 WIS and secret doors within 3 tiles are revealed automatically.

ymir_last_spawn_trophy.name: Ymir's Frozen Marrow
ymir_last_spawn_trophy.description: Marrow from the first frost-giant. Cold does you half damage and can never freeze you solid, permanently.
